title: NazarAI ML source
subtitle: nazarai_ml package: preprocessing, quality gate, training, evaluation
description: Source of the nazarai_ml Python package (NazarAI diabetic retinopathy screening, Capital Youth Expo Hackathon 2026). Shared fundus preprocessing, heuristic quality gate, EfficientNet ordinal-regression training, threshold optimisation, decision rule, ONNX export and evaluation. Copied from ml/src/nazarai_ml in the NazarAI repository.
